info.description: GoNet Drive is a self-hosted cloud file storage and sharing service.
info.title: GoNet Drive API

get.description: Return the service logo image file.
Return the Progressive Web App manifest JSON.
Get service health status and configuration info.

post.description: Authenticate with username and password. Returns JWT cookies. If MFA is enabled, a pre-auth token is returned and the client must call /api/mfa/verify.
Revoke the current session and clear all auth cookies.
Verify the TOTP code after receiving a pre-auth token from /api/login. On success, full auth cookies are set.
Exchange a valid refresh token cookie for a new access/refresh token pair.

get.description: Verify that a valid share JWT exists for the given share ID and the share is still active.
Download one or more files/directories from a shared path. Single files are served directly; multiple items are packaged as ZIP.
List files and directories within the authorized share path.

post.description: Get metadata for files/directories in a shared path.
Upload a file chunk to a shared path. Requires modify authority.

parameters.description: Chunk status: start, uploading, end, cancel
parameters.name: status

get.description: Serve media files (video, photo, music, document) from a shared path.

post.description: Verify a share link ID and PIN. On success, a share JWT cookie is set for subsequent access.

put.description: Upload a new PNG logo file. Requires admin role.

get.description: Retrieve a list of all registered users. Requires admin role.

post.description: Create a new user account. Requires admin role.

delete.description: Delete a user account permanently. Requires admin role.

post.description: Revoke all access tokens and refresh tokens for a specific user. Requires admin role.

get.description: Get all cloud configuration entries.

put.description: Update a cloud configuration entry (value, enabled status, or soft-delete).

get.description: Serve a text document file with appropriate MIME type.

post.description: Cancel a running or queued file operation by its operation ID.
Check for name collision between source and destination paths.
Check for file name collision when uploading files to a destination.
Start an asynchronous copy operation for files/directories.
Create a new directory.
Move files/directories to the recycle bin (.cloud_delete).
Permanently delete files/directories (bypass recycle bin).

get.description: Download one or more files/directories. Single files are served directly; multiple items are packaged as a ZIP.
List files and directories at the specified path. Supports sorting by name, size, or modified time.

parameters.description: Sort by: name, size, modified (default: name)
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: Show hidden files: true, false (default: false)
parameters.name: showHidden

get.description: Simple health check for the files API module.

post.description: Start an asynchronous move operation for files/directories.
Get metadata properties for files or directories.
Rename a file or directory.

get.description: Get current storage usage and limit.

post.description: Upload a chunk of a file. Supports resumable uploads with start/uploading/end/cancel status.

parameters.description: Chunk status: start, uploading, end, cancel
parameters.name: status

get.description: Get information about the currently authenticated user.
List all active refresh token sessions for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Revoke a specific refresh token family. Requires password confirmation.

post.description: Enable MFA after setting up a TOTP secret via /api/user/mfa/setup.

get.description: Generate a TOTP secret and return the secret key and provisioning URL. Requires authentication.
Stream a music/audio file.
Serve a photo/image file.
Generate and serve a thumbnail for a photo/image file.

post.description: Create a new share link for a given path with PIN protection.

get.description: Get all share links created by the authenticated user.

delete.description: Permanently delete a share link and invalidate all existing share JWTs.

put.description: Block or unblock an existing share link.

get.description: Check if the current request is properly authenticated.

post.description: Move a video file to the 'disqualified' subdirectory.

get.description: Stream a video file with HTTP range support.

post.description: Move a video file to the 'done' subdirectory with optional rotation.

parameters.description: Request with path, newName, rotateAngle, opId
parameters.name: body

get.description: Generate and serve a thumbnail image for a video file.
Simple health check for the video API module.
Establish a WebSocket connection for real-time file operation progress updates.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the JWT access token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization

CookieAuth.description: JWT access token stored as a cookie.
CookieAuth.name: access_token
